left_defects.source: und durch andere Leute darzu angetrieben / damit fortzufahren
left_defects.translation: and He urged others to proceed with it

why: Both carry Augspur-/gischen Confession across the break cleanly, but LEFT inverts who was driven to continue the writing (He urged others), which RIGHT renders correctly.

right_defects.source: Theils Geistliche stimmen wohl selbst mit den gottlosen Hauffen ... und führe / auch selbst ein exemplarisch Leben ... daß sie rechte Phariseer seyn
right_defects.translation: (absent; pre-break half begins at ue Pharisees)
always sigh, implore GOD hourly ... delivered from this miserable (content of the following page A v)

why: RIGHT is misaligned: its pre-break half renders post-break source and its post-break half renders text from a later page, omitting the pre-break passage and the crossing sentence, while LEFT renders the junction faithfully.
Both render the split word ente-/entschieden as we are / decided (resolved) and translate the following Pasquil/Responsio items without substantive defects.
Both render the split Damna-/mnatur correctly (LEFT splits it as con-/demned, RIGHT completes it before the break) and translate the following sentences faithfully.

left_defects.source: und durch andere Leute darzu angetrieben / damit fortzufahren
left_defects.translation: and He urged others to proceed with it

why: Both carry the Augsburg Confession across the break, but LEFT inverts who was driven to continue, and RIGHT continues the sentence without the ellipsis seam.
The break falls between list and closing paragraph with only a catchword crossing it; both render both sides completely and accurately.
